title: Know your Knights
author: Hempelson Tamsova
rules:
solve with SudokuPad

Normal Sudoku rules apply.

Knights and Kings: The four marked squares in the grid are lone Knights and contain a non repeating set of even digits. None of these digits can reach itself by a Knights move (in chess). Each and Every remaining even digit in the whole grid will reach itself exactly ones (Knights move).
No odd digit will reach itself by its surrounding cells (Kings move).

Arrows: Digits along an arrow sum to the digit in the connected circle.

Killer cages: All digits in a cage sum to the given total in the top left corner of the cage.

Dots: digits seperated by a white dot are consecutive.

Palindrome line: A grey line reads the same in both directions.

Little Killer Sum: the given total besides a small arrow outside the grid indicates the sum of the diagonal it points at.

Maximum Clues: A cell with four arrows facing outward must contain a digit greater than its orthogonal adjacent cells.

Greater than Clue: A > clue between two cells indicates that the digit on the open side is greater than the digit the > points at.
solutionCode: column 5 (top to bottom, 9 digits, no spaces inbetween)
